articles.title: Goldman Sachs pegs Nifty target at 26,500 by June 2027; lists 15 stocks from key themes
articles.content: Goldman Sachs has turned more constructive on Indian equities, forecasting the Nifty 50 to rebound to 26,500 by June 2027. The brokerage cited an improving macro backdrop, easing foreign selling, resilient domestic growth and attractive valuations, while recommending banks, large-cap stocks and value plays for the second half of the year.

articles.title: EM equities see $46 billion exodus in June as South Korea, Taiwan tech selloff rattles investors
articles.content: Emerging markets saw substantial equity outflows totalling $46.1 billion in June.  South Korea and Taiwan experienced the largest investor withdrawals from their stock markets.  However, emerging market debt attracted foreign inflows, showing investor preference for fixed income.

articles.title: India bonds fall as oil spike, Treasury rout weigh
articles.content: Indian government bonds experienced a decline early Monday, mirroring U.S. Treasury selloffs. Escalating U.S.-Iran tensions boosted oil prices, raising inflation concerns for India. Hopes for inclusion in Bloomberg's flagship index are expected to cushion further bond price drops. Overseas investors have shown persistent demand for Indian government bonds in July. Overnight index swap rates also saw an increase tracking offshore paying activity.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Wall Street braces for pivotal week as earnings, inflation data and Middle East tensions come into focus
articles.content: Wall Street faces a pivotal week with key economic data releases and corporate earnings. Investors will closely watch inflation figures and Federal Reserve commentary for market direction. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are also a significant concern for global energy supplies. Major banks like JPMorgan Chase will kick off the second-quarter earnings season. Robust corporate results are needed to support current market valuations amid uncertainties.

articles.title: GE Vernova, Atlanta Electricals among top beneficiaries of India's transmission expansion
articles.content: India's power transmission sector anticipates growth, with new policies supporting domestic manufacturing.  Chinese firms can participate, but strict localization rules will ensure local content.  Supply constraints in transformers are expected to ease, benefiting grid equipment suppliers.  Demand for transmission infrastructure remains strong, especially for high-voltage equipment.  GE Vernova and Atlanta Electricals are positioned to benefit from this expansion.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Inflation gathers pace as tariffs, energy costs and AI investment lift price pressures, says Fed
articles.content: U.S. inflation accelerated during spring due to tariffs and rising energy costs. The Federal Reserve's report shows inflation remains significantly above its target. The labor market has largely stabilized, with demand and supply broadly in balance. Economic growth was moderate, supported by artificial intelligence infrastructure investment. Policymakers remain divided on the outlook for future interest rate adjustments.

articles.title: Q1 surprise sends jewellery stocks shining 40% in a month. Will the surge last in next quarters?
articles.content: Indian jewellery stocks saw a 40% surge after strong June quarter business updates. Resilient demand and a shift to organized players supported this sector's impressive rally. articles.title: Just Dial shares rocket 14% as profit rises to Rs 166 crore; revenue grows 10% YoY
articles.content: Just Dial shares surged as much as 14% after the company reported strong Q1FY27 results. Net profit rose 4.1% YoY to Rs 166.2 crore, while revenue climbed 9.9% YoY to Rs 327.5 crore. EBITDA margin remained healthy at 26.7%, with quarterly unique visitors at 192.9 million. The company also ended June with Rs 6,022 crore in cash and investments.

articles.title: US Stock Market: SEC tightens disclosure rules for activist investors, raising transparency bar
articles.content: The US SEC has tightened disclosure rules for activist investors, requiring greater transparency around client identities in key regulatory filings. The new guidance could reshape shareholder activism by increasing disclosure obligations for hedge funds and special purpose investment vehicles, while reigniting debate over investor privacy, corporate governance and campaign financing.

articles.content: DMart shares fell on Monday despite reporting a healthy June-quarter performance. The company posted an 11.3% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 860.6 crore, while revenue grew 14.9% to Rs 18,794 crore. articles.content: LTM shares will be in focus after the IT company reported largely in-line Q1FY27 earnings. articles.title: SBI Funds Management IPO opens tomorrow: GMP signals 16% listing gain; Check price band, key dates & details
articles.content: SBI Funds Management will launch its Rs 11,692.91 crore IPO on July 14. Investor enthusiasm is building in the grey market, indicating a premium. The shares are tentatively scheduled to debut on July 21, 2026.
